textSegments: Toughpower GX3 series is 80 PLUS Gold certified non-modular PSU. The GX3 series is compatible with Intel’s ATX 3.0 specifications. Designed with a native PCIe Gen 5.0 connector, it can power up next-gen technology with one new 12VHPWR cable.
Power Up the Next Generation Hardware

Built to deliver 80 PLUS Gold efficiency, Toughpower GX3 non-modular PSU comes with capacities ranging from 750W to 850W, is designed to meet ATX 3.0 standards, including a PCIe Gen 5.0 12VHPWR connector. The GX3 Gold series delivers 80 PLUS Gold efficiency, it also offers stability, durability, and reliability.
Fully Compatible with Intel ATX 3.0 Standards

Toughpower GX3 Gold series is fully compatible with Intel ATX 3.0 Specifications which supports up to 200% power excursion, reaches 60% low load efficiency and complies with required power supply timing standards.
Toughpower GX3 Gold series comes with a 16pin connector to offer powerful and stable performance allowing the PSU to natively run next-generation GPUs.

The wattage marked on the 12VHPWR’s connector is the recommended wattage. (Ref. Intel design guideline) The native 16 PIN (12VHPWR) PCIe connector of the GX3 750W can deliver up to 300W for PCIe 5.0 graphics cards.
1. Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage, and many other factors.
2. Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the 12VHPWR cable.
Ultra Quiet 120mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing Fan
Featuring a 120mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing Fan to keep friction at really low levels even after prolonged usage while guaranteeing superior cooling performance and silent operation.
High quality electrolytic capacitor greatly improves the power supplies durability and ensures the Toughpower GX3 series is stability and reliability.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail & High-Class Technologies

Powerful single +12V rail can properly deliver the power you need for the best compatibility. The use of LLC and DC to DC circuit design provides very stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.

To protect the hardware, GX3 is built with industry grade protections: OCP(Over Current Protection), OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP(Under Voltage Protection), OPP(Over Power Protection), SCP(Short Circuit Protection), OTP(Over Temperature Protection).
Soft black cables come with sleeve cabling design to make cable installation an easy task while powering the system at an advantageous voltage.
80 PLUS Gold Certified and C6/C7 States Ready

Toughpower GX3 Gold series saves energy through its high energy efficiency up to 90% and is certified to 80 PLUS® Gold. It has been optimized to work with all generations of Intel’s processors to achieve maximum energy saving.
